title: Dashboard uses the FPV core's web components
goal: The dashboard shows batteries, fleet, spares and crashes with the core's web components, styled by NERV tokens
acceptance: `battery-cards.ts` is replaced by the core's components and removed
Fleet, spares and crash views appear in the FPV panel when the pack is on
Checked in a browser at desktop and phone width, light and dark
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: host custom elements in Angular, map NERV tokens, remove the old cards. Depends on the core repository's web components. Not a measurement.
